paper.title: Activity coefficients for NaCl in ethanol-water mixtures at 25°C

pressure_basis: Declared calculation condition; experimental pressure unreported.

solvent_declaration.basis: Salt-free solvent; formula-unit molality per kg mixed solvent.
solvent_declaration.molar_mass_source: Selected Figiel /4 packet, NIST solvent masses
solvent_declaration.shared_row: Literal solvent fractions from issue #730; remaining declarations prepared once using the same masses.

source_roles.I: Physical comparison: activities inferred from cell voltage and fitted reference coefficients; delta_E_mV retained as observation only.
source_roles.II: Recorded only: solvent permittivity, density, Debye–Hückel/Pitzer constants used by source models; partly previous literature.
source_roles.III: Recorded only: extended Debye–Hückel fits (Eq.4); no native source-model verification.
source_roles.IV: Recorded only: Pitzer fits (Eqs.6–8); blank C_phi retained beside source constraint.
source_roles.V: Recorded only: chemical ion-pair fits (Eqs.9–16); no neutral NaCl species in selected Figiel declaration.
source_roles.reference-coefficients: Recorded only: fitted references, shared uncertainty, instrument resolution and temperature control.

source_equations.cell_voltage: Eq.3 pp.277–278: delta_E = (2RT/F) ln(m_R gamma_R / (m gamma)); source mV. Not calculated here.
source_equations.extended_debye_huckel: Eq.4 p.279: log10 gamma = -A sqrt(m)/(1+B a sqrt(m)) + c m - log10(1+0.002 M_xy m) + Ext; Ext refers to external higher terms.
source_equations.pitzer: Eqs.6–8 pp.282–283: ln gamma = f_gamma + B_gamma m + C_gamma m^2; source coefficients in Table IV.
source_equations.pairing: Eqs.9–16 pp.284–285: K_A = (1-alpha) gamma_0 / (m alpha^2 gamma_prime^2); I=alpha m; gamma=alpha gamma_prime.

source_inconsistency.locators: Table I p.281; section 3.4 p.285; neither recalibrated.

uncertainty: Reference coefficient ±0.003 (p.287), instrument ±0.1 mV and temperature ±0.002 K (section 2.3); reference uncertainty shared within solvent series. Pointwise covariance, weighing and pressure uncertainty unknown. Criteria are not experimental uncertainties.
limitations: Esteso extended Debye–Hückel, Pitzer, neutral-pair and forward cell-voltage calculations excluded.
Selected Figiel family cites Esteso: independence from development data unestablished.
No phase-stability or global numerical-error bound claimed.

historical.legacy_results: results/data/esteso-1989-water-ethanol-nacl.csv at the record commit; producer not retained; superseded by this live comparison.
